title: Labelled drawing sheet
subject: Art & Design
unit: Summer 2: Observational drawing, pressed flowers and a scented sachet (The Scented Garden)
source: Written for art/y2 lesson 13 (Labelled drawing sheet (portal printable))
intro: Lesson 13: Look closely: drawing and pressing a flower; end-of-year quiz. Listen, look, then do the tasks with a grown-up.

box.title: Draw it carefully, then add labels with arrows

panels.title: Look for one minute
points: Notice the shape of each leaf

parts.text: Add petals one at a time
Draw the stem and a leaf

panels.title: Press a flower
points: Place it inside folded kitchen paper
Put it in a heavy book

keywords.def: a small part you notice when you look closely
write the name of a part
a coloured part of a flower

questions.q: Quiz 1: Which part of a plant takes in water? A) root B) petal C) flower
Quiz 2: Which continent is the UK in?
Quiz 3: Name the ocean round Antarctica.
Core: Draw your flower carefully and label petal, stem, leaf (and root if you can see it).
questions.a: A careful observational drawing with correct labels

questions.q: Extend: Press your flower in a heavy book with an adult.
questions.a: A flower placed in kitchen paper in a heavy book

questions.q: Stretch: Add three tiny details you noticed.
questions.a: For example: lines on the petals, a hairy stem, a jagged leaf edge
A) Look very closely. Observing means looking carefully to notice details.

questions.q: Quiz 4: How many oceans are there?
Big question: how many details did you spot in one flower?
questions.a: Any number with examples, for example: lines on petals and a hairy stem
